subject: Partner-led discovery: schedule demo with NexusGSI / next steps
messages:
From: Alex Zhou <alex.zhou@cloudbridge.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: CloudBridge Partnerships <partnerships@cloudbridge.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Jul 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Partner-led discovery / next steps with NexusGSI

Hi Marissa,

Great to meet today — really appreciated the quick overview of Redwood's Dedicated offering. NexusGSI (our integration partner) is keen to join a partner-led discovery so we can scope the marketplace integration and any infra prerequisites on their side.

Would next week work for a 60-minute technical deep dive + demo? Proposed slots (PDT):
- Tue Aug 3, 10:00-11:00
- Tue Aug 3, 14:00-15:00
- Wed Aug 4, 09:00-10:00

Attendees we suggest: Alex (CloudBridge), Priya (NexusGSI), Camila (CloudBridge partners), Marissa + Mateo (Redwood infra/solutions).

If those don't work, happy to loop back and align calendars. Also happy to share a short agenda if helpful.

Thanks,
Alex
Head of Partnerships, CloudBridge

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Zhou <alex.zhou@cloudbridge.com>
Cc: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Jul 2027 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Partner-led discovery / next steps with NexusGSI

Thanks Alex 

We can do Tue Aug 3, 14:00-15:00 PDT. Mateo will lead the technical portion (KV cache, routing, and marketplace integration requirements) and I will cover rollout and support/SLAs. Camila: confirming you as partner lead from CloudBridge.

Priya / NexusGSI 

— can you confirm availability for Tue Aug 3 14:00 PDT? If that works I will send an invite and draft agenda.

Quick ask for the meeting: if Nexus has any restrictions around private VPC peering or specific auth methods (SAML/SCIM), can you flag them beforehand so we can prep?

I'll draft a 45-60m agenda and share a MAP after confirmation.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Senior Partner Manager, Redwood Inference

From: Priya Singh <priya.singh@nexusgsi.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Alex Zhou <alex.zhou@cloudbridge.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Jul 2027 09:33:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Partner-led discovery / next steps with NexusGSI

Hi Marissa / Alex 

Thanks for the invite. Tue Aug 3 at 14:00 PDT works for us (I'm in EST but the time is fine).

Couple of quick items from NexusGSI side:
- We'll want to confirm network access patterns (outbound to Redwood endpoints) and any IP allowlists.
- Do you support brokered auth (we can recommend service accounts) or do you prefer customer-managed SSO?

If you can share an agenda and attendee list, we'll route to our infra team. Also would prefer 60m to allow time for Q&A.

Thanks,
Priya Singh
Principal Solutions Architect, NexusGSI

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priya Singh <priya.singh@nexusgsi.com>, Alex Zhou <alex.zhou@cloudbridge.com>
Cc: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@cloudbridge.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Jul 2027 10:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Partner-led discovery / next steps with NexusGSI

Perfect 

I created a calendar invite for Tue Aug 3, 14:00-15:00 PDT: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=redwood-cloudbridge-demo
Attached is a short agenda and a draft mutual action plan to capture owners and timelines.

Agenda (high level):
- 5m intros & roles
- 15m Redwood architecture overview (serving runtime, routing, security controls)
- 25m integration discussion (marketplace flow, VPC/peering, auth options)
- 10m next steps / MAP owner alignment

Pre-reads / attachments:
- Redwood_CloudBridge_Demo_Agenda.pdf (agenda + attendee list)
- RBW-CloudBridge-MAP.xlsx (mutual action plan template)

Notes / asks for NexusGSI infra: please confirm any IP ranges or ACL rules and your recommended auth flow (brokered service account vs. customer-managed SSO). Mateo will be the point for infra follow-ups.

If that looks good I'll lock the invite.

Best,
Marissa
Senior Partner Manager, Redwood Inference
